Three small missions on the island of Targuna. You help {npc:Lizzie} put an end to a lizard clan hiding in a temple, rid the island of Aragonia of pirates for {npc:Sterling} and find a buried treasure, and defeat the {creature:Herald of Fire} in the Crimson Court at {npc:Emiliana}'s request. You earn experience, platinum coins, an {item:Adventurer Backpack} and the {wiki:Reliable Ram|Reliable Ram} mount.
Level 10 for the mission **A long lost Treasure** (Sterling).
or equivalent; to dig up the treasure
Mission *Burning heat*: give the {item:Bunch of Turnips} that {npc:Emiliana} hands you to the ram on the west side of Targuna.
If you lose the turnips, Emiliana sells you more for 1000 gold.
The three missions are independent: you can do them in any order, as long as you have the required level.
Don't lose the {item:Bunch of Turnips}: if you do, Emiliana sells you another for 1000 gold.

Talk to {npc:Lizzie}, in the **south** of Targuna. Say {key:hi}, {key:save} and {key:yes}. She marks the temple entrance on your map.

{wiki:Targuna} is the island new players go to after leaving {wiki:Newhaven} (designed for levels 8 to 20): you get there at the end of the tutorial.
Go **north** and enter the {wiki:Hidden Lizard Temple|Hidden Lizard Temple} by the stairs.

Go down **one floor** and defeat the {creature:Lizard Commander}. Then enter the portal to return to Targuna. If you need to leave earlier, go up the same stairs as the entrance ({coord:31936,31863,7}).
Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Lizzie}. She tells you to visit Camilla in her office.

Go to the depot and go up the stairs to {npc:Camilla}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive **2 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}** and **1500 experience**. She says you'll find interesting things in {npc:Aurelia}'s shop.
Talk to {npc:Sterling}, on the **west** side of Targuna. Say {key:hi}, {key:adventure} and {key:yes}.
Use Sterling's sea turtle (Matilda), on the **west** coast of Targuna ({coord:31924,31904,7}), to travel for free to **Aragonia** ({coord:33513,32720,7}).
In Aragonia, kill at least **20 pirates** and collect **10 turtle eggs**. The eggs are scattered around the island: just click on them.

There are {creature:Pirate Gunner|Pirate Gunners}, {creature:Pirate Navigator|Pirate Navigators}, {creature:Pirate Cook|Pirate Cooks}, {creature:Pirate Quartermaster|Pirate Quartermasters} and {creature:Sea Captain|Sea Captains}.
Go to the cave in the **south** of Aragonia and talk to {npc:Morla}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive an {item:Old Treasure Map}.

Go back to Targuna and say {key:hi}, {key:quest} and {key:yes} to {npc:Sterling}. You receive **3000 experience** and a mark appears on your map.

To come back from Aragonia, leave Morla's cave and return to Targuna by the same means, the sea turtle.
Go to the mark, use the {item:Shovel} and open the chest to pick up the {item:Adventurer Backpack}.
Talk to {npc:Emiliana}, in the room above the training dummy in Targuna. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

Go up to the room above, open the door and enter the portal. You arrive at the **Crimson Court**. Talk to Emiliana again and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. The portal is in the room above Emiliana's house ({coord:31962,31898,5}).
Portal to the Crimson Court (Emiliana's house)
Going down to the boss portal

Go down through the Crimson Court until you reach the {creature:Herald of Fire} portal. Before the portal there are fire walls: you can switch them off by stepping on the pressure plates at the sides of the dungeon, or simply walk through them and take fire damage.

On the way there are {creature:Infernoid Blob|Infernoid Blobs}, {creature:Infernoid Hound|Infernoid Hounds}, {creature:Infernoid Soul|Infernoid Souls} and {creature:Infernoid Spiritual|Infernoid Spirituals}.
Enter the portal, stand in the **centre** of the room and pull the lever. You are teleported to the fight with the {creature:Herald of Fire}.
Kill the {creature:Herald of Fire} and enter the **purple** portal to leave the dungeon. The purple portal takes you back out of the dungeon, where you talk to Emiliana again.
Talk to {npc:Emiliana}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive **5000 experience** and a {item:Bunch of Turnips}.
Take the {item:Bunch of Turnips} to the ram on the **west** side of Targuna and give it to him. You get the {wiki:Reliable Ram|Reliable Ram} mount and the **A reliable Friend** achievement.
If you lost the turnips, {npc:Emiliana} gives you another bunch for 1000 gold.

When you want to go to the mainland, talk to {npc:Captain Indigo} on the Targuna boat: say {key:hi}, {key:thais} and {key:yes}. He only takes you to **Thais** and the trip costs **5000 gold** (or a Sail Pass).
